findings.reason: the binding node as scoped cannot make its own arm's first step possible, and an implementer discovering this mid-node either exceeds its write paths or reverts to the dispatch-time copy the section exists to replace.
findings.text: s5 says "Dispatch writes it from `--brief`" and that the first arm "queues a request with a brief, replaces its `steering.md` before launch", but no code on the queued path writes that file: `_store_brief` is called only at `reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1948`, while every queueing hold raises earlier (`dispatch.py:1676` for unmet waits, `:1795` and `:1826` for a lane hold), so a queued request's run directory is never created and holds no `steering.md`; the fix needs a writer in `dispatch.py` (or `runs.queue_dispatch`, `reckon/crew/runs.py:546`), and neither module is among s5's declared write paths (`dispatch_admission.py`, `queue_admission.py`, `crew_run_commands.py`, `mcp_crew_actions.py`, a new test file)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_store_brief` and `_brief_digest` resolve at `reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:2241` and `:2204`, `_launch_queued` and `_node_from_pointer` at `reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:171` and `:119`; `crew view live --phase queued` is real (`--phase` at `reckon/crew_run_commands.py:238`, and `LIVE_PLACEMENT_FIELDS = ("position", "rank")` at `reckon/crew/query.py:88` backs the claim that queued rows already carry both); `crew discard` exists at `reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1978`; `crew_run_commands.py` and `mcp_crew_actions.py` both exist. Each extensionless href (`a-held-dispatch-waits-its-fair-turn`, `a-coordinator-can-clear-its-own-duties`, `a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk`, `the-crew-does-its-own-bookkeeping`) resolves as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s5's discriminating arm is a genuine negative control: leaving `steering.md` alone and changing the brief the queued pointer names makes today's copy-at-dispatch code (`reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1948` calls `_store_brief`) fail the arm, and the edit-verb arm is now split from the direct-replacement arm so each build node carries its own measure.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — s5 places every log "under the run directory", i.e. the request's own directory under the configuration home, which survives the run; the plan-level evidence target `docs/evidence/archive/a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan-landed.html` exists in the repository.
rubric_items.naming: pass — s5 introduces `steering.md`, `crew queue edit/reprioritise/drop` and no plan label, ticket number or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — s5's mechanism never says who writes `steering.md` at queue time, and the only brief-store call site is unreachable on the queued path, so the binding arm's first step has no file to replace.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the section now states it is built as two nodes, launching-binding and verbs, and closes when both land; the earlier finding on this point was declined with that reasoning and the changed unit makes it explicit.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s5's declared `plan-section-depends-on` edge (s5 -> s2) names a node that exists, `s4 -> s5` and `s10 -> s4, s5` agree with the build order followup f-aqhwp-002 gives, and the cross-project edge `imas-ambix:local-lane-admission-control#s27` resolves to a live section that carries the reciprocal `reckon:a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan#s4` link.
